title: Standalone TABLECONTENT CELLSTYLEMAP base-style resolution

scope.operation: Resolve standalone TABLECONTENT base-style IDs through the rooted TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP graph and emit only uniquely mapped IDs.
scope.profile: Generated standalone TABLECONTENT with AC1024 built-in ID 4 and AC1021 custom ID 101, one rooted TABLESTYLE, its canonical extension-dictionary CELLSTYLEMAP, and ASCII/binary output.
scope.source_basis: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §20.4.102 defines ID 4 for R24 and custom IDs from 101. The adapter previously validated these joins for legacy TABLE records but omitted standalone TABLECONTENT from the rooted map census; the standalone writer refused both IDs.
implementation: Include standalone TABLECONTENT column, row and cell references in the existing rooted TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP census.
Require a unique CELLSTYLEMAP ID under the exact TABLESTYLE for standalone ID 4 and custom IDs; keep missing, duplicate, wrong-owner, reserved and pre-R24 cases refused.
Pass only resolved TABLESTYLE/base-ID pairs to the writer. Direct writer calls without adapter proof continue to reject ID 4 and custom IDs.
Verify exact ASCII/binary wire IDs, fresh typed readback, destination and caller preservation on refusal, and same-adapter corrected retry.
scope.claim_boundary: Selected generated standalone TABLECONTENT transport for AC1024 ID 4 and AC1021 custom ID 101 through a unique rooted CELLSTYLEMAP. This does not qualify native table rendering, broader style-field composition, DWG output or general CELLSTYLEMAP support.

evidence.graph_controls: Census tests cover standalone IDs 1-3, mapped custom ID 101, missing-ID same-graph repair, duplicate map IDs, wrong TABLESTYLE owner, missing TABLESTYLE handle, reserved ID 5, ID 4 without a map, ID 4 with its unique R24 map entry, and pre-R24 refusal.
evidence.physical_wire: The independent scalar walker confirms the standalone TABLECONTENT group-90 ID and matching CELLSTYLEMAP group-90 ID in ASCII and binary output.
evidence.typed_readback: Fresh ASCII and binary imports preserve the standalone style ID and TABLESTYLE reference; the matching style ID occurs exactly once in the map.
evidence.failure_controls: A missing mapped ID is refused before replacing a destination sentinel and leaves the caller's invalid style ID unchanged.
evidence.retry_control: Repairing the ID on the same adapter writes successfully; fresh readback confirms the corrected ID.

research.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §20.4.102 CELLSTYLEMAP
research.finding: CELLSTYLEMAP is attached to TABLESTYLE through its named extension-dictionary entry. IDs 1/2/3 denote title/header/data; ID 4 is the R24 table style; custom IDs start at 101.

remaining: Broader CELLSTYLEMAP body/property combinations and native table-rendering meaning remain open.
Other TABLECONTENT format/value/content graphs and DWG output remain open; this receipt does not promote a support claim.
